import hashlib,json,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.combination_capsule as capsule
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.deployment_assets import NamespaceMember
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.grading import FileBinding
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.source_closure import capture_tree

def binding(path):
 data=path.read_bytes();i=path.stat();return FileBinding(path,hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),len(data),i.st_mtime_ns)
def members(root):
 out=[]
 for i,name in enumerate(sorted(capsule.EXACT_MEMBERS)):
  p=root/f"s{i}.py";p.write_bytes(("X="+repr(name)+"\n").encode());out.append(NamespaceMember(name,binding(p)))
 return tuple(out)
results={}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="capsule-review-") as raw:
 root=Path(raw).resolve();root.chmod(0o700);profile=root/"profile";profile.mkdir(mode=0o700)
 ms=members(root);dest=profile/"synthetic"
 tree=capsule.materialize_synthetic_capsule(dest,ms)
 results["protected_profile_parent"]={"accepted":True,"destination":str(dest),"tree_files":tree.file_count}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="capsule-review-") as raw:
 root=Path(raw).resolve();root.chmod(0o700);ms=members(root);dest=root/"late-tamper"
 first=sorted(ms,key=lambda x:x.relative_path)[0]
 target=dest/first.relative_path
 def mutate_then_capture(path,limits):
  before=target.read_bytes();target.write_bytes(b"Z"*len(before));return capture_tree(path,limits)
 with patch.object(capsule,"capture_tree",side_effect=mutate_then_capture):
  tree=capsule.materialize_synthetic_capsule(dest,ms)
 results["late_destination_tamper"]={"accepted":True,"returned_tree_sha256":tree.tree_sha256,
   "source_sha256":first.source.sha256,"destination_sha256":hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
   "destination_matches_source":target.read_bytes()==first.source.path.read_bytes()}
print(json.dumps(results,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
